These are core Māori spiritual and ethical concepts.
reasoning: This is a textbook case of substantive religious/ethical tradition engagement. The paper CENTERS Māori indigenous knowledge systems including spiritual concepts (tapu, mauri) and traditional narratives (pūrākau) as an evaluative framework for AI. The entire methodology is grounded in Māori tikanga (correct way of doing) and Mātauranga Māori (Māori knowledge system). Religious/spiritual concepts are not incidental mentions but the core analytical framework.
